name: Backboard Hasp
description: Spreads a thin sheet of qi across the whole board and holds the shield steady against light blows.

name: Stubborn Shieldarm
description: Catches a descending cut on the qi-lined face so the blade stops without biting into the wood.

name: Wardflog
description: Raps the qi-hardened rim against the opponent's knuckles to make the weapon hand open.

name: Padded Bossrim
description: Locks the forearm strap tight with qi in the muscle so the shield does not shift on impact.

name: Facehurdle
description: Glides forward on the balls of the feet while the lined board stays level before the chest.

name: Gripping Cover
description: Hooks the lined edge over the opponent's weapon arm and pulls it across their own body.

name: Edgeband Prop
description: Sheathes the board in dense qi and plants it against a heavy overhead cut that would crack plain wood.

name: Ward Thwack
description: Releases the stored qi of the lined board in a hard shove that rebounds the blow back at the striker.

name: Strapslap
description: Drives the boss upward under the opponent's chin from close range while the board covers the torso.

name: Dire Buffet
description: Drags the sharpened rim along the opponent's gripping hand with a short pulling motion.

name: Enarmeglide
description: Slides the lead foot forward as the boss thrusts out so reach and cover arrive together.

name: Stubborn Enarme
description: Rotates the boss in a small circle to sweep a thrusting blade out to the side.

name: Faceslap
description: Chains a rim strike straight into a shoulder drive with qi flowing from arm to hip between them.

name: Enarmeflog
description: Hammers the boss into the chest with qi concentrated at its point and the full weight of the legs behind it.

name: Enarmeslap
description: Beats the rim against head and ribs and hand in a rapid cascade without lowering the board.

name: Guarding Face
description: Angles the face of the board so a cut glances off its surface at a shallow slant.

name: Layered Enarme
description: Holds the board half-turned toward the strike line so it can meet blows from either flank.

name: Dense Backboard
description: Rolls the wrist to sweep the board across and push a stabbing blade out of line.

name: Tenderhearted Face
description: Sends a thread of qi along the shield arm to feel an impact's direction before it lands fully.

name: Buffetscorer
description: Turns the board's edge into the opponent's wrist the moment a deflected blade passes by.

name: Enarmezip
description: Pivots on the front foot so the board follows the opponent's circling sword without a gap.

name: Layered Bossrim
description: Spirals the board and the qi in it against a heavy blow so the blow's force is carried round and away.

name: Shovebuckle
description: Jams the board against the opponent's turning weapon and breaks the rhythm of the whole attack.

name: Raw Shoulderset
description: Completes the turn with the board swinging into the opponent's flank with qi gathered along the arm.

name: Layered Rim
description: Sets the board's edge overlapping a comrade's so no gap shows between the two shields.

name: Bossglide
description: Steps forward with the whole line on one shared beat while the boards stay locked edge to edge.

name: Unmoving Backbrace
description: Braces every shoulder against the next to meet a charge as one body behind the boards.

name: Rim Swerve
description: Slides sideways into a gap where a neighbour has fallen and re-closes the line at once.

name: Fierce Edgeband
description: Jabs the rim forward together with the line over the boards to hit the front rank's hands.

name: Pirouetting Boss
description: Wheels the end of the line around a fixed shield to face an enemy appearing on the flank.

name: Facescreen
description: Raises the boards overhead in a joined roof against missiles falling from above the line.

name: Pulse Strap
description: Links neighbouring shields by a shared flow of qi so a blow on one is spread across the line.

name: Weighty Shove
description: Advances the braced line a pace at a time so the enemy is pressed steadily back by weight and qi.

name: Staticbash
description: Drives every shield forward on one count so the combined force breaks a charging enemy front.

name: Rude Shove
description: Answers a blocked blow by shoving the board straight out before the opponent can recover.

name: Cooling Strap
description: Reads the instant the opponent's weapon rebounds off the board and strikes in the gap.

name: Rushing Boss
description: Drives the shoulder behind the board into an opponent whose swing has just spent itself.

name: Buffet Stalk
description: Steps square to the opponent's line and bashes in the same breath for a short answer.

name: Rimscorer
description: Releases a pulse of qi through the board at the moment of contact so the reply bash lands heavier.

name: Clutching Backbrace
description: Follows one bash with a second at the stumbling opponent's weapon side to break their next attack.

name: Rooted Shieldarm
description: Plants the tall tower shield's base in the ground so the board shelters the whole body.

name: Layered Backbrace
description: Leans the shoulder into the tower shield's face to hold it upright against a heavy push.

name: Lithe Bash
description: Tilts the tower shield on its lower edge and slides it forward by small drags of the base.

name: Guarding Rim
description: Slants the tall board forward so falling stones and arrows run off its face and past the bearer.

name: Bossslap
description: Drops the iron-shod base of the tower shield onto the opponent's foot when they close in.

name: Wardstalk
description: Steps out from behind the tower's edge and back again before the opponent can answer.

name: Buttressed Boss
description: Sinks qi through both legs to anchor the bearer so the tower shield does not move when struck.

name: Swift Bash
description: Tips the tower shield forward to fall onto the opponent with qi driven down through the arms.

name: Shielding Strap
description: Spins the small round shield by the handgrip so cuts from any side meet its curving face.

name: Bossrim Buckle
description: Moves the small board in a quick circle before the chest to cover high and low in turn.

name: Bossflog
description: Flicks the round rim at the opponent's eyes or wrist as the shield comes around.

name: Shove Hurdle
description: Steps off the line while the round shield spins to turn the bearer's body behind it.

name: Clutching Bash
description: Swaps the shield between hands at the moment of cover to give the opponent a false side.

name: Sturdy Shieldarm
description: Whirls the round shield with a stream of qi to turn a rapid flurry of cuts without stopping.

name: Acrid Ward
description: Passes the sharp round edge across the opponent's guard in a slashing pass lent speed by qi.

name: Staticbuffet
description: Stabs with the short sword in the heartbeat after the board has taken the opponent's cut.

name: Staticward
description: Thrusts the short sword low beneath the board's lower rim into the opponent's thigh.

name: Sleet Face
description: Rests the sword hand against the shield's rim so both weapons move as one guard.

name: Brawn Backboard
description: Slips the short blade past the boss to prick at the opponent's arm without opening the cover.

name: Rimhurdle
description: Closes the distance in two small steps with board forward and sword drawn back for the stab.

name: Discord Buffet
description: Checks the opponent's sword wrist with the board's edge while the short sword threatens the ribs.

name: Crimson Shoulderset
description: Hides a qi-driven stab behind the board's face so the point arrives where the opponent cannot see it.

name: Weighty Enarme
description: Pins the opponent's blade between the boss and the sword's crossguard and holds it with qi.

name: Honed Buffet
description: Beats the rim against the guard and thrusts the short sword through the gap it opens.

name: Buttressed Edgeband
description: Slants the board against an arrow's flight so the shaft skips off the face and away.

name: Guarding Strap
description: Crouches behind the board as a crossbow bolt arrives and lets it strike the thick wood.

name: Guarding Shieldarm
description: Turns a thrown spear off the board's edge so its point drives into the ground beside the bearer.

name: Rallying Bossrim
description: Watches the arc of a volley over the rim to judge which boards must lift and which stay low.

name: Armored Enarme
description: Angles the board sideways to catch darts that fly from the flank rather than the front.

name: Strapglide
description: Walks forward with the board raised at a steady slant while missiles strike its face.

name: Rude Edgeband
description: Shakes lodged arrows off the board with a sharp jerk and strikes with the freed rim.

name: Layered Backboard
description: Hardens the board with qi and slopes it to shed a heavy volley of bolts and stones.

name: Rim Carapace
description: Takes a thrown spear on the board and sets it free on the strike line for the next opponent.

name: Coasting Bash
description: Rushes forward in the lull after a volley with qi in the legs and the board slanted high.

name: Clay Backbrace
description: Sets the board square and the feet wide so the whole body can press without losing cover.

name: Strapzip
description: Presses forward one heel at a time with the board's face held against the opponent's body.

name: Brawnbash
description: Grinds the board's rim against the opponent's ribs while pressing forward step by step.

name: Clay Bossrim
description: Braces against an opponent's counter-push and finds the footing to continue pressing forward.

name: Clayshove
description: Pours a continuous stream of qi into the board's pressure so the opponent's footing steadily gives.

name: Lassoing Boss
description: Shoves when the opponent's rear foot lifts to topple their balance and end the press.
